content:
This is the file defining the topology of 𝔖-convergence on the space of continuous linear maps. It got quite long and messy, so in #37440 I split it into three parts:

  • the general case
  • the case of bounded convergence
  • the case of compact convergence

The diff is quite scary, but this has the potential to rot quite quickly, so if anyone has time for it a review would be greatly appreciated!
